title: TFW, DamnGina, Juvie, and Hotsie-Totsie: On the Linguistic and Social Aspects of Internet Slang
reasoning: The paper includes a specific study of religious stereotypes and prejudices within Internet slang. Section 4.2 and Figure 11 quantify and analyze how different religious terms (e.g., Islam, Christianity, Judaism, Buddhism) are associated with various biased descriptors like 'terrorist', 'illegal', 'good', and 'sexy' using word embeddings.
